failure_stage: first observed source-only inner comparator transport before any observed metric, null, bootstrap, result artifact, or candidate selection was produced

diagnosis.cause: The implementation first repaired the mutable subset to its original compensated sum and then performed a second repair using a differently ordered whole-panel compensated sum. The second repair changed the mutable-subset sum by floating-point roundoff while preserving the whole-panel sum.

authorized_mechanical_repair: Remove the redundant second repair. Define both original and candidate panel totals with the same immutable-plus-mutable compensated partition. Because immutable coordinates are byte-identical and the mutable compensated sum is exact, this proves exact panel mass conservation without changing any transported value after the frozen mutable-sum repair.
